title: Index-calculus boundary ledger
claim_hygiene: Public synthetic / known-answer fixtures only. Primary vs_rho claims use exactly one unseen target paired on the identical public point and resource envelope. Headline time is verified online wall after reusable IC preparation; exclude process launch, input loading, target generation, and target-independent setup. Multi-target averages, batch throughput, and shared-table amortization are secondary only and require a separate declared question after the primary one-target result. Never combine best component costs from different runs into a synthetic win.
ffd_vs_rank_la: FFD / degree_of_regularity apply to Boolean Macaulay / Gröbner algebra of Semaev (decomposition). Relation-matrix LA over F_r is stage rank; never conflate the two.

factor_base.notes: orbit_count_K may equal |F| when no orbit reduction applies; state that explicitly.

decomposition.ffd_requirement: Algebraic frontier claims (groebner / F4 / SAT on Semaev systems) must measure FFD/DoR (min/max/mean over draws). Enumerate / pairs_and_solve may set ffd.status=inapplicable with reason, but must still record system degree and unknowns when a polynomial system exists.
